delivery.gaplessRule: After decodeAudioData: if buffer.length >= sourceSamples + encoderDelaySamples the decoder did NOT apply the MP4 edit list -> add encoderDelaySamples/48000 s to loopStart/loopEnd and to one-shot start offset; otherwise use them as-is. Always set loopEnd = loopStart + sourceSamples/48000 (never buffer.duration), so the 2048-sample safety tail (a copy of the loop start for loops, silence for one-shots) and AAC padding are never played as part of the loop.
